title: As the Sun Sets
summary: Marlon finds his old boss shot at his house and gets knocked out afterwards.
method: The victim was only faking their death when Marlon discovered their body. They were actually shot later, confusing the time of death and establishing an alibi for the killer.
motive: The victim refused to give the killer money. The killer went to jail for a crime the victim also was involved in.
notes:
Marlon's last episode, as he leaves to Jamaica for a new job.
JP makes an appearance.
tags: victim fakes their death then dies for real
